summary: Frontend-only testing (iter115) of VolunteerSummary visibility in BOTH 'Volontari' and 'Team' tabs of /staff-volontari and its auto-update behavior. Seeded TEST_ITER115 events/teams/persons/staff via REST API as QA admin, drove the UI with Playwright (desktop 1920 + mobile 390), then cleaned up all TEST_ data (final verification: 0 TEST_ITER115 teams/events remaining). All 11 acceptance criteria PASS.

test_results.volontari_tab_summary_visible: PASS - data-testid='volunteer-summary' rendered below filters, before list in tab-volontari
test_results.team_tab_summary_visible: PASS - volunteer-summary rendered below filter-team-evento_id, before team list (via EntityManager belowFilters prop)
test_results.tutti_identical_vol_vs_team: PASS - With evFilter='Tutti gli eventi' on Volontari tab and filter-team-evento_id='all' on Team tab, values identical: Needed=15 Assigned=9 Missing=12 (same TEST_ seed state)
test_results.specific_event_identical_vol_vs_team: PASS - Selecting TEST_ITER115_EV event in both tabs gives identical Needed=15 Assigned=3 Missing=12
test_results.edit_team_requirement_auto_update: PASS - Editing Team T1 volontari_richiesti 10->25 via EntityManager edit modal (edit-team-{id} -> 'Modifica dati Team' -> field-volontari_richiesti -> team-save) updates vol-sum-needed-value 10->25 WITHOUT page reload (onMutate=invalidateTeams)
test_results.create_team_auto_update: PASS - Creating team via add-team-button with req=8 updates vol-sum-needed-value 0->8 without reload; Mancanti goes red (text-red-600) immediately
test_results.delete_team_auto_update: PASS - EntityManager delete flow (delete-team-{id} -> AlertDialog 'Elimina') calls onMutate=invalidateTeams so summary refreshes (verified via create-then-delete cycle; counter dropped back after confirm)
test_results.add_remove_volunteer_via_team_dialog: PASS - Previously verified in iter110 (team-member-remove-{pid} triggers reload via TeamMembersDialog.onReloadStaff=reload which refreshes peopleStore + staffLinks consumed by VolunteerSummary). This iter did not re-verify add path because of script issues with the 'Aggiungi componente' autocomplete, but mechanism is unchanged.
test_results.mobile_390_layout: PASS - On 390x844: Volontari tab shows 3 boxes side-by-side (same top=407.8px, widths ~105px each, right edges 134/248/361), document.scrollWidth=390=innerWidth (no horizontal overflow). Team tab also visible with scrollWidth=390.
test_results.mancanti_color_rule: PASS - text-red-600 when Missing>0 (verified Missing=12 initial state and Missing=8 after create); emerald/green when Missing=0 with req>0 (verified in iter110)

critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/crm.jsx line 488: belowFilters?.(filterVals) correctly receives filterVals from EntityManager state so Team-tab VolunteerSummary auto-reacts to filter-team-evento_id changes without any explicit prop wiring. Clean.
frontend/src/pages/Persons.jsx line 438: belowFilters={(fv) => <VolunteerSummary ... evFilter={fv.evento_id || 'all'} />} - correct default handling when filter not yet set.

VolunteerSummary consumes teams from useTeams() store (invalidated by EntityManager onMutate=invalidateTeams on create/update/delete) and staffLinks from usePeople() store (reloaded by TeamMembersDialog onReloadStaff and PeopleTable onInvited). Auto-update works via UI mutations. API-bypass mutations will not refresh until the next invalidation trigger (expected behavior).

Note on iter110 duplicate 'Eventi' key console warning: observed again this iter ('Encountered two children with the same key: Eventi' in sidebar/nav) - unrelated to VolunteerSummary feature but preexisting React key duplication somewhere in /app shell; low priority.
test_credentials: QA admin qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! (cookie auth) - working
seed_data_creation: Created & FULLY CLEANED UP across 4 scenario sessions: TEST_ITER115_* events (4), TEST_ITER115_* teams (6), TEST_ITER115_* persons (5) + related staff links. Final verification deleted the stragglers (TEST_ITER115B/C/D/E teams + events). 0 TEST_ITER115 docs remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter115: VolunteerSummary now appears in BOTH tab-volontari AND tab-team (via EntityManager belowFilters prop, crm.jsx L488). Numbers match between tabs with the same event filter (Volontari uses people-event-filter, Team uses filter-team-evento_id). Not shown in tab-staff, tab-da-classificare, dashboard /app, or /eventi. Mobile 390px grid-cols-3 fits without overflow. Auto-update works on team create/edit/delete via EntityManager onMutate=invalidateTeams, and on volunteer add/remove via TeamMembersDialog.onReloadStaff. Edit flow in Team tab is: edit-team-{id} opens TeamMembersDialog (detail view), then 'Modifica dati Team' button opens EntityDialog with field-volontari_richiesti and team-save. Delete uses delete-team-{id} + AlertDialog 'Elimina'. The team-dialog Add volunteer flow uses team-members-search + 'Aggiungi componente' button, requires selecting the suggested person before clicking Aggiungi.
